name: Jair Eden
source: He is a physical wizard who wields a giant magic sword. An orphan who has never known his parents, and has studied swordsmanship and magic under a certain wizard since he was a child. He grew up with Milla and loves her like a younger sister and somehow wants to turn her, a homunculus, into a human.
